config.improvedsnowlayers.title: Improved Snow Layers
config.improvedsnowlayers.category.gener: Control which blocks are allowed to receive phantom snow layers
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.checker: How a block's 4 horizontal neighbors are judged to decide if it should receive a phantom snow layer. 3 of 4: at least 3 of 4 must be snow. Prefer Snow: shows snow if snow-neighbors >= air-neighbors (ties favor snow). Prefer Air: shows snow only if snow-neighbors > air-neighbors (ties favor air). All Sides: all 4 neighbors must be snow.
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.useRayS: Instead of only looking at a block's 4 immediate neighbors, climb over solid neighbors (like a raised grass block) to find the real snow or air surface beside it before deciding. This can flip a checker mode's outcome for uneven terrain, but a snow source found more than 1 block away currently has no visible effect: phantom layers are still only ever rendered right next to a real snow block, so raising the horizontal distance above 1 mainly affects eligibility bookkeeping, not what actually renders.
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.maxHori: How many blocks outward each direction is allowed to search when Extended Neighbor Search is on. Only affects eligibility - phantom layers still only render adjacent to a real snow block, so values above 1 rarely change what you actually see and cost more performance per candidate block. Has no effect when Extended Neighbor Search is off.
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.maxVert: How many blocks up or down Extended Neighbor Search is allowed to climb to find the open surface in a direction (e.g. to see over/under a raised or sunken neighbor). Has no effect when Extended Neighbor Search is off.
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.reduceZ: Renders phantom snow layers with a very slightly widened model so their edges don't flicker/z-fight against the exactly-flush faces of the block they're rendered onto. Only affects phantom layers - real snow blocks are never changed.
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.whiteli: If not empty, only these blocks/tags may receive phantom snow layers. Prefix an entry with # to match a block tag (e.g. #minecraft:fences), otherwise use a block id (e.g. minecraft:oak_fence).
config.improvedsnowlayers.option.blackli: Blocks/tags listed here never receive phantom snow layers, even if they match the whitelist. Prefix an entry with # to match a block tag (e.g. #minecraft:fences), otherwise use a block id (e.g. minecraft:oak_fence).
